_doc: EXP-1145: a PLAIN Merge control on a member of a PR stack asks first, x4 (web lib/pr-stack.ts stackMergeChoice; desktop pr_stack::stack_merge_choice; iOS PrStack.stackMergeChoice; Android PrStack.stackMergeChoice). Input: the issue being merged + the synced issue rows (id, identifier, branch, prBaseBranch, prState, prUrl). Only OPEN pull requests form the chain (stackChain over the open rows in identifier order); choice is null when the issue has no open PR or its chain has fewer than 2 open members -> merge plainly, no dialog. Otherwise the dialog: title, listing (members bottom to top joined by ' → ', the merged one suffixed ' (this one)', a batch PR named 'EXP-2 +1'), the two sentences, body = listing + blank line + stackSentence + newline + thisSentence; buttons mergeStack (issues.mergePr({issueId: topIssueId, mergeStack: true})), mergeThis (the plain single-PR merge), cancel. The Reviews queue's own rows keep reviews-merge.json.
